Daily Volume 1,07,185 Source: ENDU, Choice Institutional Equities Q2FY27: Strong Revenue performance, EBITDA margin lower than estimate ▪ Revenue was up 33.6% YoY and 10.9% QoQ to INR 47,862 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 44,359 Mn) ▪ EBITDA was up 17.2% YoY and 4.3% QoQ to INR 5,590 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 5,811 Mn).
EBITDA margin fell to 11.7% (-163 bps YoY) on higher raw material and conversion costs.
We expect customer price increases and favourable commodity movements to support margin recovery.
valuation: View and Valuation: We lower our FY27/28E EPS estimates by ~17%/16%, respectively, factoring in weaker-than-projected Q2FY27 performance and delayed margin recovery.
We maintain our valuation at 30x average FY28/29E EPS and revise our target price to INR 3,000 (earlier: INR 3,380).
watch: Positive outlook with gradual margin recovery: The management remains constructive, supported by premiumisation, EV adoption, localisation and new customer programmes.
However, strong order visibility, EV-led growth and capacity ramp-up support our positive outlook.
